ns2:course.label: Plants and Their Uses
ns2:course.description: Consideration of plants which are useful or harmful: their origins and history, botanical relationships, chemical constituents which make them economically important, and their roles in prehistoric and modern cultures and civilizations. Same as ANTH 378. Prerequisite: IB 102, IB 103, or IB 150; or consent of instructor.
